guidelines.title: Cabin Ventilation Shutdown Protocol During Suspected Fire Events
guidelines.recommendation: Immediately shut down all inter-module ventilation (IMV) and recirculating fan systems upon any primary smoke or ionization trigger.
guidelines.rationale: In microgravity, convective air current is the sole mechanism driving fresh oxidizer to a flame. Ceasing ventilation induces immediate radiative quenching and starves the flame boundary layer.

guidelines.title: Material Qualification in Exploration Atmospheres (Low Pressure, High O2)
guidelines.recommendation: All habitable module non-metallic materials must pass NASA STD-6001 Test 1 at 34% O2 and 56.5 kPa (8.2 psia) rather than standard 21% O2 / 101.3 kPa.
guidelines.rationale: Lunar suit ingress/egress protocols utilize hyperoxic low-pressure environments to prevent decompression sickness, drastically reducing ignition thresholds for common plastics.

guidelines.title: Photoelectric Light-Scattering Smoke Detectors Deployment
guidelines.recommendation: Mandate dual-wavelength photoelectric optical scattering smoke detectors alongside off-gas trace analyzers, replacing reliance on ionization detectors.
guidelines.rationale: Microgravity soot aggregates into large chain structures with aerodynamic diameters exceeding 300 nm, to which ionization detectors exhibit poor responsiveness.

guidelines.title: Post-Extinguishment Thermal Quarantine and Cool Flame Surveillance
guidelines.recommendation: Maintain a minimum 45-minute post-extinguishment thermal camera inspection before restoring module airflow or removing crew breathing apparatus.
guidelines.rationale: FLEX-2 experiments established that low-temperature cool flames and smoldering can silently persist after visible extinction, re-igniting explosively when airflow returns.

guidelines.title: Prohibition of Cast Acrylic (PMMA) in Pressurized Crew Compartments
guidelines.recommendation: Ban all cast PMMA (Plexiglass/acrylic) from pressurized habitable zones; replace with transparent polycarbonate with flame-retardant surface coatings or toughened borosilicate glass.
guidelines.rationale: PMMA sustains violent flame propagation with dripping flaming liquid droplets that scatter across microgravity cabins under nominal ventilation.

guidelines.title: Fine Water Mist Extinguisher Deployment in Crew Quarters
guidelines.recommendation: Deploy portable water mist extinguishers (15-30 µm droplet MVD) as primary first-response units in crew living quarters, reserving CO2/gaseous suppressants for uncrewed equipment racks.
guidelines.rationale: Fine water mist avoids crew asphyxiation hazards inherent to CO2 flooding in confined habitat volumes, while providing 55% greater cooling efficacy in microgravity.

guidelines.title: Electrical Harness Thermal Sensor Array and Overcurrent Protection
guidelines.recommendation: Install distributed fiber-optic Bragg grating temperature sensors along primary power bus wiring harnesses and avionics raceways.
guidelines.rationale: Wire insulation pyrolyzes up to 60 seconds prior to open arc ignition in microgravity; early thermal detection enables automated load shedding before pyrolyzate accumulation.

guidelines.title: Partial Gravity (0.16g) Ventilation Duct Staggering in Lunar Bases
guidelines.recommendation: Stagger ceiling supply and floor return ventilation duct registers to prevent forming vertical chimney-effect convection columns in 0.16g.
guidelines.rationale: Lunar 0.16g produces partial buoyancy that accelerates flame spread rates by up to 20% compared to pure microgravity, making natural vertical draft channels especially dangerous.

guidelines.title: 3D-Printed Component Infill and Surface Sealing Standards
guidelines.recommendation: All additively manufactured polymer parts (PEEK, Ultem 9085) produced in space must undergo vapor smoothing and be oriented with layer lines perpendicular to airflow.
guidelines.rationale: Porosity between 3D-printed layers acts as capillary oxygen delivery paths, accelerating combustion propagation along layer boundaries by 22%.

guidelines.title: ECLSS High-Efficiency Particulate Air (HEPA) Pre-Filter Sacrificial Barriers
guidelines.recommendation: Incorporate automated fire-damping isolation valves and sacrificial pre-filters ahead of main ECLSS catalytic oxidizers and CO2 scrubbers.
guidelines.rationale: Microgravity fires generate double the soot volume fraction of 1g fires, and suspended ash can permanently blind catalytic life support beds within minutes.

guidelines.title: Nomex-Kevlar Protective Blanket Staging Near Lithium Battery Bays
guidelines.recommendation: Store multi-layer Nomex/aerogel fire blankets adjacent to all lithium-ion battery storage lockers and spacesuit recharge racks.
guidelines.rationale: Battery thermal runaway in 0g creates directional jets of burning electrolyte and incandescent particles that easily ignite adjacent non-metallic bulkheads.

guidelines.title: Low-Pressure Habitat Fire Depressurization Procedure
guidelines.recommendation: Design surface habitat modules with emergency rapid depressurization valves capable of dropping module pressure below 15 kPa within 90 seconds.
guidelines.rationale: Depressurization starves combustion below limiting oxygen partial pressures without requiring massive consumable chemical extinguishing agents.

guidelines.title: Silicone and Sealant Quantity Limits in Pressurized Volumes
guidelines.recommendation: Enforce strict mass limits on RTV silicone sealants and require fluorosilicone or metal-jacketed metal c-rings for primary hatch seals.
guidelines.rationale: Burning silicone produces free-floating abrasive silica (SiO2) micro-ash that remains perpetually airborne in 0g, presenting acute corneal and inhalation hazards.

guidelines.title: Real-Time Carbon Monoxide Electrochemical Sensor Thresholds
guidelines.recommendation: Set autonomous alarm thresholds for CO at 25 ppm (warning) and 50 ppm (emergency breathing gear donning), well below terrestrial 150 ppm standards.
guidelines.rationale: Microgravity fires yield an 7× higher CO/CO2 ratio than well-ventilated 1g fires due to incomplete diffusion burning, causing rapid crew incapacitation.

guidelines.title: Electrostatic Active Extinction in Unmanned Avionics Bays
guidelines.recommendation: Implement 5 kV DC grid electrodes inside sealed avionics chassis for remote flame detachment and quenching without gas discharge.
guidelines.rationale: ACME E-Field experiments demonstrated instant flame lift-off and extinction in under 1.2 seconds, preserving delicate electronics from corrosive residues.
